usageNotes: Returns the list of sub-resource directories available under a specific storage pool on a given node — this is a directory index, not a content listing. Use it to discover which child endpoints (e.g. 'content', 'status', 'rrd') are reachable for the storage before drilling deeper. Requires either Datastore.Audit or Datastore.AllocateSpace on /storage/{storage}; the node must be online and the storage must be configured and accessible on that node.

examples.summary: List available sub-resources for the 'local-zfs' storage on node 'pve1'

tips: The returned 'subdir' values are the child path segments — append them to this path to reach endpoints like /nodes/{node}/storage/{storage}/content or /nodes/{node}/storage/{storage}/status.
If the storage is disabled or not mounted on the target node, the API will return an error even if the storage ID is valid in the cluster config.
Shared storages (e.g. NFS, Ceph) may return the same subdirs from any node that has them mounted, but per-node storages (e.g. local, local-lvm) only exist on their own node.
